Labor Markets and Wages 
Due to the pandemic, the economy lost almost 22.2 million jobs last year over March and April, 
including 21.4 million jobs in the private sector.  However, payroll job growth resumed in May 
2020, and labor markets reclaimed 14.1 million jobs between then and April 2021, or nearly 64 
percent of the total lost.  Nonetheless, total employment was still 8.2 million persons lower than 
the level in February 2020.  Weekly initial unemployment claims have continued to trend lower

pandemic levels in the second quarter and should return to trend by late-2021 / early-2022.

quarter of 2020.  The advance estimate is based on incomplete source data and will be revised in
